deployment_assumptions: Devices using these N-Type regions are assumed to be difficult or impossible to update post-deployment. Design-time controls and robust manufacturing practices are emphasized.
open_questions: What specific dopant materials and concentrations are used in the N-Type regions?
What thermal conditions does the device typically endure, and how are these measured?
How robust are current supply chain audits and fabricator integrity checks?
prioritization_summary: Threats and requirements are prioritized based on the criticality of maintaining junction resistance, preventing junction leakage, and controlling dopant diffusion within a non-updatable context.

prioritized_actions.next_step: Develop thermal models and validate against performance benchmarks.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Addresses the most severe post-deployment consequence related to diffusion.
prioritized_actions.title: Thermal Management Design

prioritized_actions.next_step: Implement enhanced calibration checks and process control measures.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Direct impact on device integrity; requires immediate process intervention.
prioritized_actions.title: Junction Leakage

prioritized_actions.next_step: Initiate a third-party audit of current doping processes and suppliers.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Strategically important in early stages to prevent value-chain manipulation.

security_requirements.description: Mitigate junction leakage through precise control of doping processes and equipment calibration.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Tight controls on process variances maintain junction integrity without needing updates.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Directly addresses manufacturing-level threat with robust, unchanging process controls.
security_requirements.requirement: Shall implement sub-5% variance process control in doping concentrations to prevent leakage.
security_requirements.title: Precision Doping Process Control
security_requirements.verification_method: Periodic equipment calibration and process monitoring logs.

security_requirements.description: Prevent dopant diffusion by maintaining controlled thermal profiles during operation.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Thermal management is integrated during design, mitigating diffusion risk over the device's life.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Necessary to ensure dopant stability under all expected operating conditions.
security_requirements.requirement: Should design thermal profiles that operate below known diffusion acceleration temperatures.
security_requirements.title: Thermal Management Design
security_requirements.verification_method: Simulation and thermal profile testing before production.

security_requirements.description: Ensure doping process integrity through robust supply chain verification steps.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Addresses supply chain threats by ensuring integrity before assembly is complete.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Balances supply chain complexity with verifiable protection against tampering risks.
security_requirements.requirement: Shall implement verification measures to ensure doping levels remain as designed during manufacturing.
security_requirements.title: Supply Chain Doping Verification
security_requirements.verification_method: Third-party audits and material inspections pre-assembly.

summary: Assessment of N-Type regions in doped areas focusing on junction integrity and resistance to process variations, ensuring robust design due to post-deployment immutability.

threats.attack_surface: Physical process variations in doping concentration.
threats.deployment_consequence: Hard to detect or fix post-manufacture; can require device replacement.
threats.description: Unintended current flow across the doped regions, which can degrade performance and reliability.
threats.potential_impact: Increased power consumption or circuit failure due to leakage.
threats.priority_rationale: Junction leakage directly impacts device integrity and operation, necessitating precise implementation controls.
threats.scenario: Process variation leads to elevated dopant concentrations, forming unintended conductive paths.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Leakage is introduced during process implementation and must be controlled with precise doping techniques.
threats.title: Junction Leakage

threats.attack_surface: Thermal conditions during operation or testing.
threats.deployment_consequence: Design choices cannot be altered post-deployment; diffusion effects are cumulative over time.
threats.description: Uncontrolled movement of dopants from the intended regions, affecting device characteristics.
threats.potential_impact: Changes in electrical characteristics, leading to reliability issues.
threats.priority_rationale: Post-deployment consequence of device alteration is severe; design choices must be finalized before manufacturing.
threats.scenario: High-temperature operation causes dopants to diffuse, altering junction properties.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Diffusion can be managed early in design by selecting appropriate dopant species and process temperatures.
threats.title: Dopant Diffusion

threats.attack_surface: Supply chain and fabrication process integrity.
threats.deployment_consequence: Detection post-fabrication is economically unfeasible; impacts device authenticity and trust.
threats.description: Unauthorized changes to the doping levels, potentially affecting device function and security.
threats.potential_impact: Device may not perform to specifications, leading to security vulnerabilities.
threats.priority_rationale: While critical, the managed supply chain can mitigate this risk; however, impacts are severe if unaddressed.
threats.scenario: Supply chain manipulation results in altered dopant levels, impacting circuit logic.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Risks introduced by inadequate supply chain controls during doping process steps.
threats.title: Implant Dose Tampering
